# Bridges that hand off to client code only when called from the client
common/src/main/java/uk/nbforge/gallifreyan_chronicles/compat/jade/GCJadePlugin.java  # registerClient only runs on the client
common/src/main/java/uk/nbforge/gallifreyan_chronicles/compat/portal/TardisPortalBridge.java  # client methods are only called by client renderers and mixins
common/src/main/java/uk/nbforge/gallifreyan_chronicles/core/block/InteriorDoorBlock.java  # guarded by level.isClientSide()
